_note: v1, 2026-08-31: seeded at client-namespace creation for the pay-transparency drive (first Brunswick project: projects/paytrans). Governed doc_ ids for the corpus sources. Registry creation is itself the deliberate governing act here (there was no prior Brunswick registry to propose into); grown afterwards only by proposal + adoption like the Astellas tier. The three large pptx sources were ingested via their structured extractions (file_to_structured_all_md.py, Jan 2026) with the binaries retained by BPS; that derivation is provenance, recorded here and in the project manifest, not hidden.
